message:
I still remember the time we had a big snowstorm roll in. My grandkids were all set for a weekend of board games and hot cocoa. As the snow piled up outside, we lit candles and turned off the TV—didn’t want to miss the chance for some good old-fashioned family storytelling. 

It felt like we were tucked away in our own little cozy world, despite the howling wind outside. Who knew a snowstorm could create such a lovely memory? It’s a gentle reminder that sometimes, turning a challenging situation into a cozy event can be the best preparation of all. 

What’s your favorite way to make the best of a stormy day?
